Visual Breakdown

Example of Long Subject Breakdown

Soal TOEFL sering menyamarkan subjek utama dengan modifier panjang. Bedah struktur untuk menemukan Head Noun sejati.

Case #1: Prepositional Modifier The development of modern communication technologies has changed education.
Subject Lengkap The development of modern communication technologies
Head Noun (Inti) development
Post Modifier of modern communication technologies
Verb Utama has changed
Object education
Case #2: Adjective Clause Modifier The students who study linguistics often perform well.
Subject Lengkap The students who study linguistics
Head Noun students
Post Modifier who study linguistics
Verb Phrase often perform
Adverb well
Case #3: Gerund Phrase Subject Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age improves cognitive flexibility.
Subject Lengkap (Gerund Phrase) Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age, Learning sebagai head.
Verb Utama improves
Object cognitive flexibility
Case #4: Noun Clause Subject [What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition] remains controversial.
Subject Lengkap (Noun Clause) What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition
Main Finite Verb remains
Complement controversial
Case #5: To Infinitive Subject To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs are the main goals of the new environmental policy..
Subject Lengkap (To Infinitive) To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs
Main Finite Verb are
Complement the main goals of the new environmental policy
sections.content-verbs:
Arsitektur Verb

Klasifikasi Verb dalam TOEFL Structure

Memahami kedudukan kata kerja dan fungsinya (Finite vs Infinite) adalah kunci utama menjawab soal TOEFL.

1. Berdasarkan Kedudukan (Ordinary vs Auxiliary)

Ordinary Verb

Kata Kerja Utama

Memberikan makna substantif dalam klausa. Pasti ada dalam setiap klausa utuh.

Auxiliary Verb

Kata Kerja Bantu

Membantu ordinary verb membentuk tenses, aspek, modalitas, atau penekanan. 

Variasi Auxiliary Verb:

a. Primary Aux

be, do, have

b. Modal Aux

can, could, shall, should, may, must

Harus V1 bare setelah modal

c. Emphasize Aux

do / does / did (benar-benar)

Contoh penerapan

Miss Farih will have been teaching for 6 months in UIN Gusdur.

Aux: will have been   Ord: teaching

2. Berdasarkan Fungsi (Finite vs Infinite Verb)

Bentuk Verb Status Finite Syarat & Penjelasan Aturan
V1 (Bare) FINITE Berdiri sendiri (Present) atau setelah Modal.
Vs / es, V2 ALWAYS FINITE Selalu berfungsi sebagai Kata Kerja Utama Kalimat.
V-ing CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be (be + V-ing).
V3 (Past Participle) CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be atau have.
To + Infinitive ALWAYS INFINITE Tidak pernah bisa menjadi Verb Utama Kalimat.
sections.content-decomposition:
Analisis

Sentence Decomposition

Pelajari bagaimana kata kerja tampak (V-ing / V3) terbentuk akibat proses pemangkasan (reducing) klausa penjelas.

Case 1: Reduced Adjective Clause (V-ing) Active Reduction
"The students studying in the library are preparing for the TOEFL test."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• studying = Infinite Verb

• are preparing = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The students [who are] studying..."

Case 2: Reduced Adverbial Clause (Having + V3) Perfective Participle
"Having completed the research, the professor submitted the article."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• Having completed = Infinite Verb Phrase

• submitted = Finite Verb Utama (V2)

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "[After the professor had] completed..."

Case 3: Reduced Passive Adjective Clause (V3) Passive Reduction
"The book written by the famous linguist has become popular."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• written = Infinite Verb

• has become = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The book [which was] written..."

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Obj of Prep TIDAK PERNAH bisa menjadi subjek kalimat!

Dalam TOEFL, preposisi berfungsi sebagai modifier, pelengkap, atau keterangan untuk menunjukkan hubungan kata benda dengan bagian lain dalam kalimat.

01

Rumus Prep + Obj

Selalu diikuti noun, noun phrase, atau gerund.

02

Menghindari Pengecohan

Tidak terkecoh noun setelah prep sebagai subjek.

03

Prep vs Conjunction

Membedakan kata serupa (after, before, as).

04

Subject-Verb Agreement

Menyelaraskan verb dengan Head Noun sejati.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Terkecoh Objek Preposisi

Mengira Noun setelah Preposisi sebagai Subjek Utama Kalimat.

❌ Salah: To the students, the exam were difficult.

✓ Benar: [To the students], the exam was difficult.

Kata students adalah objek dari preposisi to, bukan subjek. Subjek aslinya adalah the exam.

Pitfall #2 Tertukar dengan Conjunction

Bingung Membedakan Kata yang Berfungsi sebagai Prep vs Conj.

✓ Prep: After dressing up... (Diikuti Gerund)

✓ Conj: After I dress up... (Diikuti S + V)

Kata seperti after, before, as , dll. bisa menjadi preposisi atau konjungsi tergantung struktur setelahnya.
sections.content-formula:
Rumus Utama & Variasi Bentuk

Preposition + Object of Preposition

Preposition berfungsi sebagai modifier, pelengkap, atau keterangan. Bentuknya sangat bervariasi: in, on, at, despite, because of, before, after, as, in front of, dll.

5 Variasi Bentuk Object of Preposition:

1

Noun (Kata Benda)

Prep + Noun
• The book on table belongs to me.
2

Noun Phrase (Frasa Kata Benda)

Prep + Noun Phrase
• She lives in a modern apartment in Jakarta.
3

Pronoun (Kata ganti)

Prep + Pron
• Many students like me like history.
4

Gerund / Gerund Phrase (V-ing)

Prep + Gerund/Phrase
• He succeeded by studying diligently.
• They got promoted after completing the annual project.
5

Noun Clause (Klausa Kata Benda)

Prep + Noun Clause
• We are worried about what the committee decided yesterday.

Contoh Analisis Struktur Dasar:

"To the students, the exam was difficult."
Prep To
Obj of Prep the students (n.p)
Subject the exam
Verb was
Complement difficult
sections.content-lab:
PERBEDAAN

Preposition vs Conjunction

Beberapa kata memiliki bentuk yang sama persis namun berkedudukan ganda sebagai Preposition atau Conjunction. Bedakan strukturnya:

Preposition Pattern

Prep + Obj of Prep

Diikuti oleh kata benda, noun phrase, atau gerund (tanpa subjek mandiri).

"I will pick you up after dressing up."
Conjunction Pattern

Conj + Subject + Verb

Diikuti oleh klausa utuh yang memiliki subjek dan kata kerja (finite verb).

"I will pick you up after I dress up."
💡 Catatan Linguistik:

Kedua kalimat di atas memiliki arti yang persis sama saat diterjemahkan. Pada kalimat pertama, bentuk dressing up menjadi gerund karena terjadi penghapusan subjek I setelah preposisi after.
sections.content-cases:
Further Examples

Advanced Prepositional Phrase & Inversion Analysis

Pembedahan tingkat lanjut untuk memastikan agar tidak terkecoh oleh preposisi berlapis.

"On the rim of Bromo caldera, the sulfurous smoke rises against the backdrop of a vast, misty sand sea."
▫️ Prepositional Phrase:

On the rim of Bromo caldera berfungsi sebagai adverb of place (keterangan tempat).

▫️ Subject & Verb:

Subject: the sulfurous smoke (Noun Uncountable). Verb: rises (menggunakan V-s).

▫️ Keterangan:

Objek preposisi Bromo caldera bukan subjek kalimat.

"Under the authority of the KPK, the Regent of Pekalongan was arrested for alleged involvement..."
▫️ Prepositional Phrase:

Under the authority of the KPK berfungsi sebagai adverb keterangan tambahan di awal kalimat.

▫️ Head Noun & Verb:

Subjek utamanya adalah the Regent (Bupati). Kata Pekalongan adalah objek preposisi of yang menjadi modifier.

▫️ Subjective Agreement:

Karena Head Noun tunggal (regent), verb yang dipakai adalah was (bukan were).

Special Case: Inversion Inversion Trigger
"On the hill stands an ancient Buddhist temple."
▫️ Prepositional Phrase (Keterangan Tempat):

On the hill diletakkan di awal kalimat untuk penekanan (prepositional phrase of place).

▫️ Fenomena Inversi (Inversion):

Karena keterangan tempat ada di depan, terjadi pembalikan posisi: Verb (stands) mendahului Subject (an ancient Buddhist temple).

▫️ Tips TOEFL:

Jangan keliru mengira objek preposisi (hill) sebagai subjek. Subjek aslinya adalah temple (tunggal), sehingga verb-nya menggunakan bentuk tunggal stands.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Participle Berfungsi Sebagai Adjective untuk Menjelaskan Noun.

Participle (Present V-ing atau Past V3) dapat berfungsi sebagai kata sifat murni atau penanda klausa reduksi (*reduced relative clause*). Jangan terkecoh mengira participle berdiri sendiri sebagai finite verb utama kalimat.

01

Finite vs Infinite

Membedakan verb utuh dengan participle adj.

02

Present vs Past

Makna aktif (V-ing) vs pasif (V3).

03

Pre-M & Post-M

Posisi sebelum atau sesudah noun.

04

Participle vs Gerund

Membedakan V-ing adj dengan V-ing noun.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Terjebak Participle sebagai Verb Utama

Mengira participle (V-ing / V3) yang berdiri sendiri sebagai predikat kalimat.

Contoh Soal Jebakan:

❌ Salah: The activists murdered in 2004 Munir. (Tanpa verb utama)

✓ Benar: The activists [murdered in 2004] was Munir.

Kata murdered di sini adalah past participle sebagai post-modifier, bukan verb utama kalimat. Kalimat tetap memerlukan verb utama (was Munir.).

Pitfall #2 Tertukar dengan Gerund

Mengira V-ing yang berkedudukan sebagai noun (gerund) sebagai adjective participle.

Contoh Perbandingan Gerund vs Participle:

✓ Gerund (Noun): Swimming in deep water requires professional training. (Berfungsi sebagai subjek/benda)

✓ Participle (Adjective): The swimming instructor rescued the child. (Menjelaskan noun instructor)

(Swimming) pertama: Gerund berfungsi sebagai benda, sedangkan kedua, (swimming): present participle berfungsi sebagai kata sifat.
sections.content-blueprint:
Blueprint & Jenis Participle

Mengenal Present & Past Participle

Participle adalah kata yang dibentuk dari kata kerja, namun kategori dan fungsinya berubah menjadi adjective (kata sifat) yang menjelaskan noun.

2 Jenis Participle Utama:

1

Present Participle (Pr.Pcp) -> V-ing

Active / Ongoing Meaning
• The protesting students demanding policy changes. (Aktivis yang sedang protes - aktif)
2

Past Participle (Ps.Pcp) -> V3

Passive / Completed Meaning
• The murdered activists; The hidden evidence. (Pasif / selesai)
📌 Catatan Penting (Finite vs Infinite):

Participle berfungsi murni sebagai adjective saat berdiri sendiri atau membentuk frasa modifier. Participle baru akan berubah menjadi verb (Finite) apabila ia didampingi oleh auxiliary verb pasangannya, seperti be + V-ing (Continuous) atau have/be + V3 (Perfect / Passive).
sections.content-positions:
Positional Lab

Pre-Modifier vs Post-Modifier (Reduced Relative Clause)

Participle dapat diletakkan sebelum noun (Pre-Modifier) atau sesudah noun (Post-Modifier sebagai hasil reduksi klausa adjektiva).

1. Pre-Modifier (Present Participle) Reduced Adjective Clause
"The crying girl needs a hug."
Asal Klausa:

The girl who cries needs a hug.

Hasil Reduksi:

crying (pr.pcp) adalah hasil penghilangan konjungsi+verb [who cries]. 

Bedah Struktur:

Subject: The crying girl | Head: girl| Verb: needs| Obj: a hug.

2. Post-Modifier (Present Participle) Reduced Adjective Clause
"The man meeting me was my friend."
Asal Klausa:

The man who met me was my friend.

Hasil Reduksi:

meeting (pr.pcp) adalah hasil penghilangan konjungsi+verb [who met].

Bedah Struktur:

Subject: The man meeting me | Head: man | Verb: was | Comp: my friend.

3. Post-Modifier (Past Participle) Reduced Passive Clause
"The activists murdered in 2004 was Munir."
Asal Klausa:

The activists who were murdered in 2004...

Hasil Reduksi:

Penghapusan who were menyisakan past participle murdered in 2004*.

Bedah Struktur:

Subject: The activists murdered in 2004 | Head: activists | Verb: was | Comp: Munir.

4. Complex Subject with Participle Phrase Advanced Subject Analysis
"Experiments using gene therapy represent a giant step into the future."
Subject Utama:

Experiments using gene therapy

Head & Modifier:

Head: Experiments. Post-Modifier: using gene therapy (Present Participle Phrase).

Verb Utama:

represent (Verb plural mengikuti head noun experiments).

Comparative Lab

Membedakan Participle V-ing vs Gerund V-ing

Sama-sama berakhiran *-ing*, namun memiliki fungsi gramatikal yang sangat berbeda di dalam struktur kalimat.

Present Participle (Adjective)

Berfungsi Menjelaskan Noun

Bertindak sebagai kata sifat (modifier) yang mendampingi atau menerangkan kata benda.

"The protesting students..." (Students yang sedang protes)
Gerund (Noun)

Berfungsi Sebagai Benda

Bertindak sebagai kata benda murni yang dapat menjadi subjek, objek, atau pelengkap.

"My hobby is fishing." (Fishing = hobi saya)

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Coordinating Conjunction : Penghubung 2/lebih hal yang setara (Parallel Structure).

Dikenal dengan singkatan FANBOYS (For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So). Unsur yang dihubungkan wajib memiliki kedudukan dan bentuk gramatikal yang setara, serta aturan tanda baca koma yang ketat saat menghubungkan klausa.

01

Kaidah FANBOYS

For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

02

Aturan Koma

Wajib koma antar klausa, opsi koma untuk list.

03

Parallelism Lab

Variasi noun, adj, gerund, inf, dan clause.

04

Inversi & S-V Match

Aturan nor inversion & kesesuaian verb.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Parallelism Mismatch Trap

Menghubungkan dua unsur berbeda jenis (misalnya Gerund dengan To-Infinitive).

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: He wants to listen or singing on the stage.

✓ Benar: He wants to listen or to sing on the stage.

Unsur sebelum dan sesudah konjungsi harus setara secara gramatikal (sama-sama to-infinitive atau gerund).

Pitfall #2 Nor Inversion Failure

Gagal melakukan inversi (pembalikan posisi auxiliary dan subjek) setelah konjungsi Nor.

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: Motorola is not familiar anymore, nor Siemens is.

✓ Benar: Motorola is not familiar anymore, nor is Siemens.

Setelah nor, struktur kalimat wajib mengalami inversi (auxiliary is mendahului subjek Siemens).
sections.content-blueprint:
Blueprint & Klasifikasi FANBOYS

Aturan Penghubung Coordinating Conjunction

FANBOYS memiliki aturan spesifik terkait level gramatikal yang dihubungkan (Word, Phrase, Gerund, To-Infinitive, maupun Clause) beserta penanda strukturalnya.

Klasifikasi Fungsi & Contoh Analisis TOEFL:

1

And, But, Or

Word, Phrase, Gerund, To-Inf, & Clause

Dapat menghubungkan kata tunggal, frasa benda, gerund, to-infinitive, maupun klausa utuh dengan struktur paralel:

Contoh Word (Kata):

The committee evaluated syntactic [and] semantic patterns in the corpus.

Contoh Clause (Klausa Lengkap S + V):

The historical archives were preserved digitally, [but] the original paper documents deteriorated.

2

For, Nor, Yet, So

Strict Clause Connectors

Wajib menghubungkan antar klausa utuh (memiliki Subjek dan Verb di kedua sisinya) dan diawali koma:

Contoh Soal TOEFL (For / So / Yet):

The TOEFL examinee studied rigorously for months, [so] she successfully achieved a score above 600.

📌 Aturan Tanda Baca Koma (Punctuation Rule):
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan 2 unsur setara (misal: 2 subjek, 2 gerund, atau 2 to-infinitive), tidak perlu koma. Contoh: My father and I go.
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan lebih dari 2 unsur (list/rincian), gunakan koma pemisah. Contoh: My father, Luna, and I go.
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan 2 klausa utuh (S + V), wajib diberi koma sebelum konjungsi. Contoh: I am writing the letter, and you will send it.
sections.content-parallel:
Parallel Structure Lab

Variasi Elemen Paralel & Analisis Warna

Lab ini membedah berbagai variasi elemen gramatikal (Noun, Adjective, Gerund, To-Infinitive, hingga Auxiliary Verb) yang dihubungkan oleh Coordinating Conjunction dengan pembedaan warna khusus: Elemen 1 & 2 (Indigo), Conjunction (Emerald), serta Verb / Penanda (Amber).

1. Noun Phrase Parallelism Object Position
"The researcher collected phonological data and syntactic records."
Elemen Pertama:

phonological data (Noun Phrase sebagai Objek).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

and (Coordinating Conjunction tanpa koma karena hanya 2 unsur).

Elemen Kedua:

syntactic records (Noun Phrase setara sebagai Objek).

2. Adjective Parallelism Complement Position
"The linguistic theory was innovative, yet complex."
Elemen Pertama:

innovative (Adjective sebagai Subject Complement).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

yet (Menghubungkan dua adjektiva berlawanan makna dengan koma).

Elemen Kedua:

complex (Adjective setara sebagai Subject Complement).

3. Gerund Phrase Parallelism Subject / Object Position
"Prof. Muhandis enjoys analyzing manuscripts or teaching semantics."
Elemen Pertama:

analyzing manuscripts (Gerund Phrase).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

or (Coordinating Conjunction).

Elemen Kedua:

teaching semantics (Gerund Phrase setara).

4. To-Infinitive Parallelism Infinitive Phrase
"The institute aims to preserve local dialects and (to) publish dictionaries."
Elemen Pertama:

to preserve local dialects (To-Infinitive).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

and (Partikel 'to' pada elemen kedua boleh dihilangkan).

Elemen Kedua:

(to) publish dictionaries (To-Infinitive setara).

5. Shared Auxiliary Verb Parallelism Verb Phrase
"He is waving his arms and (is) shouting at us."
Verb Pertama:

is waving (Auxiliary is + Present Participle).

Konjungsi & Penghilangan:

and. Auxiliary (is) pada verb kedua boleh ditiadakan.

Verb Kedua:

(is) shouting (Setara bentuk V-ing).
sections.content-inversion:
Advanced Rules

Nor Inversion & Subject-Verb Agreement (Proximity Rules)

Memahami aturan inversi khusus setelah konjungsi Nor (tanpa mencampur aturan Neither) serta aturan kesesuaian verb dengan subjek terdekat (Proximity Rule) lengkap dengan bentuk yang benar dan salah.

Aturan Inversi Nor

Nor + Auxiliary + Subject

Setelah konjungsi nor, klausa wajib dibalik (auxiliary verb mendahului subjek).

✓ Benar (Inversi):

Motorola is not familiar, nor is Siemens.

❌ Salah (Non-Inversi):

Motorola is not familiar, nor Siemens is.

Penjelasan: Setelah nor, subjek 'Siemens' tidak boleh mendahului auxiliary 'is'.
Proximity Rules (Or / Nor)

Subject Agreement by Proximity

Ketika dua subjek dihubungkan oleh or atau nor, verb disesuaikan dengan subjek yang berada paling dekat dengan posisi verb.

✓ Benar (Singular Closer):

Salma or Nadia needs to go.

Nadia (singular) dekat dengan verb -> needs.
❌ Salah (Mismatch):

Salma or Nadia need to go.

Penjelasan: 'Nadia' bersifat tunggal, sehingga verb 'need' tidak sesuai.
✓ Benar (Plural Closer):

Salma or her friends need to go.

Friends (plural) dekat dengan verb -> need.
✓ Benar (Plural Closer):

No teacher nor students were present at the meeting.

students (plural) dekat dengan verb -> were.
❌ Salah (Mismatch):

No teacher nor students was present at the meeting.

Penjelasan: 'students' bersifat jamak, sehingga verb 'was' tidak sesuai.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Noun Clause Berfungsi Sama dengan Noun (Benda) dalam Kalimat.

Sebagai klausa yang bertindak sebagai benda, Noun Clause (NC) dapat menempati posisi Subject, Object, Object of Preposition, atau Subject Complement dengan pola dasar mutlak: Conj + S + V, serta variasi konjungsi sistematis dan aturan lanjutan yang esensial untuk TOEFL tingkat tinggi.

01

Pola Dasar NC

Conj + Subject + Verb (Statement order).

02

Empat Posisi NC

Subject, Object, Obj of Prep, Complement.

03

Hidden Rules

If vs Whether, Reduced NC, & Appositive.

04

Subjunctive Rule

Wajib V1 / should setelah kata penunjuk penting.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Inverted Order Trap in NC

Menggunakan susunan tanya (Inverted S-V) di dalam Noun Clause padahal posisinya di tengah kalimat.

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: I don't know where is Hasfa.

✓ Benar: I don't know where Hasfa is.

Di dalam Noun Clause, susunan kata wajib berupa Subject + Verb (statement order), bukan Verb + Subject.

Pitfall #2 Subjunctive Agreement Violation

Mengikuti kaidah subject-verb agreement standar pada *that-clause* yang menuntut bentuk Subjunctive.

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: It is vital that every student passes the test.

✓ Benar: It is vital that every student pass the test.

Meskipun subjek (student) tunggal, kata sifat penunjuk penting/saran mewajibkan verb dasar (V1).
sections.content-positions:
Systematic Conjunction Matrix

Posisi Noun Clause & Variasi Konjungsi Lengkap

Noun Clause mencakup variasi konjungsi secara sistematis: Question Words (5W1H), That (dapat dihilangkan), dan If/Whether. Berikut perincian contoh di setiap posisi:

1. Noun Clause as Object S + V + [Conj + S + V]
• Variasi 5W1H (Where):

"I don't know where Hasfa is."

• Variasi That (Eksplisit & Dihilangkan):

"I know that UIN Gusdur is in Pekalongan." (Atau: "I know UIN Gusdur is in Pekalongan.")

• Variasi If / Whether (Apakah):

"She asked whether the research grant was approved."

2. Noun Clause as Subject [Conj + S + V] + V
• Variasi 5W1H (What):

"What he said about environmental policies shocked everyone."

• Variasi That (Bahwa):

"That the economy is recovering is obvious."

• Variasi Whether (Apakah):

"Whether the seminar will be held tomorrow remains unclear."

3. Noun Clause as Subject Complement S + To Be + [Conj + S + V]
• Variasi 5W1H (Why):

"The core issue is why certain cultural traditions are forbidden."

• Variasi That:

"My primary assumption was that the corpus data was accurate."

• Variasi If / Whether:

"The question is whether the committee will approve the grant."

4. Noun Clause as Object of Preposition S + V + Prep + [Conj + S + V]
• Variasi 5W1H (Who):

"The documentary focuses on who is behind the deforestation."

• Variasi Whether (Khusus setelah Preposisi):

"They are arguing about whether the policy should be revised." (Catatan: 'if' tidak lazim setelah preposisi, gunakan 'whether').
sections.content-advanced:
Advanced Grammar Nuances

Aturan Tersembunyi (Hidden Rules) & Subjunctive Noun Clause

Kuasai aturan lanjutan berikut untuk mengantisipasi jebakan tingkat tinggi dalam soal struktur TOEFL.

Nuance 1: Aturan Khusus If vs. Whether Preposition & Infinitive Constraint

Meskipun if dan whether sama-sama berarti "apakah", keduanya tidak bisa saling menggantikan dalam kondisi berikut:

✓ Setelah Preposisi (Wajib Whether):

"They argued about whether to revise the policy."

Tidak boleh menggunakan 'about if'.
✓ Di depan To-Infinitive:

"She decided whether to accept the grant."

'Whether' dapat langsung diikuti inf, 'if' tidak.
Nuance 2: Reduced Noun Clause Question Word + To-Infinitive

Noun Clause yang berfungsi sebagai Object atau Complement (diawali question words) dapat diringkas menjadi infinitive phrase jika subjek kedua klausa sama.

Klausa Penuh:

"She didn't know what she should do."

Klausa Tereduksi (Reduced):

"She didn't know what to do."

Nuance 3: Noun Clause vs. Appositive Clause Abstract Noun + That + S + V

Jangan terkecoh dengan Appositive Clause yang diawali kata that. Appositive tidak menggantikan noun, melainkan menjelaskan noun abstrak di depannya (seperti the fact, the idea, the rumor).

✓ Contoh Appositive Clause:

"The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone."

That-clause di atas menjelaskan kata benda abstrak 'fact', bukan sebagai objek langsung.
Nuance 4: Subjunctive & Should Insertion V1 / Bare Infinitive & Should

Setelah ungkapan keharusan/penting, Noun Clause mewajibkan verb bare [dapat disisipi should dalam British English].

✓ Contoh Subjunctive Formal:

"It is crucial that he attend (or should attend) the meeting."

Opsi seperti 'attends' atau 'attended' otomatis salah di tes TOEFL.

📌 Konsep Dasar Subjunctive

Jika sebuah Noun Clause diawali dengan kata-kata yang menyatakan keharusan atau kepentingan (seperti important, vital, essential, mandatory, suggest, demand, insist, require, propose), maka verb di dalam that clause wajib menggunakan bentuk dasar (V1 / bare infinitive), terlepas dari apakah subjeknya tunggal atau jamak.

❌ Salah (Mengikuti Agreement Biasa):

"It is important that every student passes the TOEFL test."

✓ Benar (Menggunakan Subjunctive V1):

"It is important that every student pass the TOEFL test."

Meskipun 'student' tunggal, karena ada kata 'important', verb wajib V1 ('pass', bukan 'passes').
Adjectives (Kata Sifat Pemicu):
  • Important (penting)
  • Vital (sangat penting)
  • Essential (esensial)
  • Mandatory (wajib)
  • Necessary (perlu)
  • Crucial (penting)
Verbs (Kata Kerja Pemicu):
  • Demand (menuntut)
  • Insist (mendesak)
  • Require (membutuhkan)
  • Suggest (menyarankan)
  • Propose (mengusulkan)

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Adjective Clause (AC) Berfungsi Menerangkan Head (Noun / Pronoun).

AC bertindak sebagai kata sifat dalam bentuk klausa yang diletakkan langsung setelah noun, indefinite pronoun, demonstrative pronoun, atau personal pronoun yang diterangkannya.

01

Subject & Object

Relative pronoun berdasarkan fungsinya.

02

Adverbs & Whose

Where, when, why, dan kepemilikan.

03

Clause Reduction

Aturan dan variasi reduksi klausa.

04

Diagnostic Quiz

20 Soal (Blank & Error Analysis).

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Redundant Pronoun Trap

Menulis ulang pronoun objek (him, it, them) setelah relative pronoun.

❌ The man whom I met him is Ferry.

✓ The man whom I met is Ferry.

Relative pronoun sudah menggantikan noun tersebut, jadi pronoun tambahan tidak diperlukan.

Pitfall #2 Who vs. Whom

Memakai whom saat klausa membutuhkan subjek, atau sebaliknya.

❌ The boy whom helped her ...

✓ The boy who helped her ...

Setelah relative pronoun ada verb → who (subject). Setelah relative pronoun ada subjek baru → whom (object).

Pitfall #3 Subject-Verb Agreement di dalam AC

Pada RPS, verb mengikuti head noun, bukan noun terdekat.

❌ The books that is on the shelf are mine.

✓ The books that are on the shelf are mine.

Pada RPO, verb justru mengikuti subjek baru: "The books that she writes ..."

Pitfall #4 Reduksi yang Salah Bentuk

Memakai V-ing / V3 setelah ordinal number, superlative, atau the only; atau meninggalkan sisa "who/which" di klausa tereduksi.

❌ She is the first woman winning the prize.

✓ She is the first woman to win the prize.

❌ Students who studying here ...

✓ Students studying here ... / who are studying here ...
sections.content-pronouns:
Relative Pronouns

RPS (Subject) dan RPO (Object)

Perbedaan utamanya: apa yang ada tepat setelah relative pronoun. Jika verb, itu RPS. Jika subjek baru, itu RPO.

RPS: Relative Pronoun as Subject Noun + [who / which / that + Verb ...]

Relative pronoun langsung diikuti verb. RP tidak boleh dihilangkan. Verb mengikuti head noun. Pilihan RP: who / that (orang), which / that (benda).

Noun + who + V
The man who speaks is Ferry Irwandi.
Noun + which + V
I like Gus Ulil's delivery which makes us engage.
Noun + that + modal + V
Yusuf is a boy that can speak Arabic.
Noun + who + be + V-ing
The students who are waiting outside are nervous.
Noun + which + be + V3 (pasif)
The manuscript which was reviewed by Nur Hayati is accepted.
Plural head → verb plural
The books that are on the shelf belong to Sinta.
Indefinite / demonstrative + who + V
Anyone who cheats will be disqualified. / Those who arrive late must wait.
RPO: Relative Pronoun as Object Noun + [whom / which / that / ∅ + Subject + Verb ...]

Relative pronoun diikuti subjek baru dan verb. Verb mengikuti subjek baru itu, bukan head noun. Pilihan RP: whom / that (orang), which / that (benda), atau dihilangkan (zero pronoun).

Noun + whom + S + V
The man whom I met is Ferry Irwandi.
Noun + that + S + V
The book that I read is Madilog.
Noun + which + S + V
The software which we installed is free.
Noun + ∅ + S + V (RP dihilangkan)
I have something you like. / The book I read is Madilog.
Subjek baru lebih panjang
The theory which the author explained in chapter two is controversial.
Verb mengikuti subjek baru
The books that she writes are popular.

Perbedaan Struktur dalam Satu Lihat

RPS : The man who saw me ... (RP + verb)

RPO : The man whom I saw ... (RP + subjek + verb)

RPS tidak bisa dihilangkan; RPO bisa (The man I saw).
sections.content-adverbs:
Relative Adverbs & Possessive

Relative Adverbs (Where, When, Why) & Whose

Relative Adverbs

Setelah where / when / why, klausa harus lengkap (S + V). Konstruksi: Noun + where / when / why + S + V

WHERE (= in / at / on which) bisa dihubungkan dengan:

place, city, country, house, building, area, region, situation

Demak is the city where Raden Patah established the sultanate.

WHEN (= in / on / during which) bisa dihubungkan dengan:

time, day, year, moment, period, season, century, era

I remember the moment when Gus Dur was impeached.

WHY (= for which) bisa dihubungkan dengan:

reason

Many people know the reason why the movie was blocked.

Where atau which?

The city where I lived is Kudus. ✓ (klausa lengkap)
The city which I visited is Kudus. ✓ (visited butuh objek)
❌ The city where I visited last week ...
Possessive: Whose

Menyatakan kepemilikan (his/her/its/their). Konstruksi: Noun + whose + Noun (tanpa article) + V

I met the writer whose book is very famous.
The researcher whose book I reviewed is a professor. (whose + noun + S + V)
The building whose roof collapsed was old. (head benda)
❌ whose the book / who's book / whose his book
Preposition + Whom / Which

Preposisi boleh di depan RP (formal, hanya whom/which) atau tetap di akhir klausa.

The professor to whom I spoke is from Leiden.
The professor (whom) I spoke to is from Leiden.
❌ The professor to that I spoke ... / The professor whom I spoke ...
sections.content-reduction:
Adjective Clause Reduction

Reduksi Adjective Clause

Reduksi dengan V-ing, V3, dan phrase hanya untuk RPS. Pada RPO, konjungsi (RP) cukup dihilangkan.

1. Menjadi V-ing (aktif)

Buang RP + be, atau buang RP lalu ubah verb (present) menjadi V-ing.

The man who is speaking is my professor.
Participants who are not attending the session will be contacted.
A policy which affecting millions of workers was approved. (which affects → affecting)
Anyone who wishing to join must register. (who wishes → wishing)
2. Menjadi V3 / Past Participle (pasif)

Buang RP + be, sisakan V3.

The manuscript which was reviewed by Nur Hayati is accepted.
The bridge which is being built will open soon.
The candidates who have been selected will be notified.
3. Menjadi Prepositional / Adjective Phrase / Appositive

Jika predikat berupa be + PP / adjective / noun, buang RP + be. Noun phrase menjadi appositive dengan koma.

be + PP
The book which is on the table is mine.
be + adjective phrase
The students who are eager to learn improved quickly.
be + single adjective (pindah ke depan noun)
The people who are diligent succeed. → The diligent people succeed.
be + noun (appositive)
Jakarta, which is the capital of Indonesia, is a megacity.
4. Menjadi With / Having

Verb have/has diganti with (paling natural) atau having.

A house which has with three bedrooms is for sale.
Students who have having completed the course may take the exam.
5. Menjadi To Infinitive

Dipakai setelah head tertentu. Bentuk: to + V (aktif), to be + V3 (pasif), not to + V (negatif). RP dan modal dibuang. Setelah head ini, V-ing salah (the first man walking).

Ordinal number (the first, second, third, next, last)

Neil Armstrong was the first man who walked to walk on the moon.
She was the second woman who was to be elected as rector.
The next train that will to arrive at platform 2 is express.

Superlative (the best, the most important, the youngest, the largest)

She is the youngest student who has to win the olympiad.
This is the best way that we can to learn vocabulary.
It is the tallest building that has ever been ever built in the city. (pasif + ever → ever V3)

The only (the only person / one / way / thing)

Rina was the only candidate who passed to pass all the tests.
The only thing that can be to be done is to wait.
She was the only one who did not to complain.

Indefinite pronoun (something, anything, nothing, someone, anyone, no one)

I need someone who can to help me.
She has nothing that she can to wear.
He has no one whom he can to talk to. (preposisi tetap ada)
She wants something interesting to read. (adjective sebelum to V)

Indefinite quantity (much, many, little, few, a lot of, plenty of, enough, several)

There is a lot of work that we have to do.
She has little time that she can to spare.
There are many problems that must be to be solved.
We have enough money to buy a laptop.

💡 Bedakan makna: someone to help me = yang dapat membantu; someone helping me = yang sedang membantu.

Yang Tidak Bisa Direduksi
RPO (ada subjek baru) → hanya RP dihilangkan
The man met is Ferry. → The man whom I met is Ferry.
Simple past aktif → makna bergeser
The man stealing the bag was arrested. → The man who stole the bag was arrested.
Whose
The writer book is famous. → The writer whose book is famous.
Preposition + whom/which
The method with analyzing ... → The method with which we analyzed ...
Modal di luar special head
A tool can detecting plagiarism → A tool which can detect plagiarism
